about: The per-port counts the bridge sent in each inform during the 2026-11-15 alert tests on Network 11.0.99 (docs/drivers/sonic.md 11.23), beside the alerts the controller raised (system-log-device-alert-bridged.json, same order). link_flap: DX010 port 17, an empty cage looped and unlooped by the chip's MAC loopback, its link_down_count (the bridge's own payload-last.json, read every 15 s); the alert came at the 00:19:14 inform with COUNT 123. stp_flap: the stub switch's port 3, its stp_state_change_count[0].change_count grown by the test file (the stub's informs); the alert came at the 00:27:02 inform with COUNT 63. Times are UTC, the inform's own.
